title: Site Quality Review
methodology: Reuses verified, already-certified evidence from AQ-02B and AQ-05A/B wherever available (re-deriving it would be a re-estimate), adding fresh checks specific to AdSense-review site-quality concerns (placeholder content, spam indicators) that no prior audit specifically targeted.

broken_pages.evidence: 0 broken links encountered in the AQ-02B4/AQ-05A BFS reachability crawl across the full published site.

empty_pages.evidence: 0 pages with empty JSON-LD or empty narrative sections (AQ-02A QA, reconfirmed structurally in AQ-04).

thin_pages.evidence: 100% of leaf/group/category pages have authored narrative content present (reports/google-indexability.json). However, reports/helpful-content-review.json (AQ-06B) found that for 328 leaf entities (4 domains), that content is a single templated sentence with no supplementary depth — thin in substance even though not thin in Google's narrow 'has prose at all' sense. Cross-referenced here rather than re-assessed, to avoid duplicating that finding under a different label.

duplicate_pages.evidence: 0 duplicate canonical URLs (AQ-05A, 1,038/1,038 unique). The 8 AQ-03 canonical-identity variety-pairs were separately evaluated for content duplication in AQ-05D and found genuinely differentiated — not duplicate pages by any reasonable reviewer standard.

navigation.evidence: 10/11 domain hubs live and working, /ingredients/ master directory, working breadcrumbs on every page, working site search covering 1,038 entities (AQ-02B, reconfirmed AQ-05B).

search.evidence: Client-side site search index covers 100% of published food-ontology entities (AQ-02B2).

discoverability.evidence: Every published page reachable through 3 independent discovery paths — navigation, sitemap, search (AQ-05B).

internal_links.evidence: 0 unsupported relationships across 4,140 checked (AQ-02B3); 0 orphaned pages (AQ-02B4, reconfirmed AQ-05A after AQ-04B's full regeneration).

orphan_pages.evidence: Same reachability-crawl evidence as internal_links above — 0 orphans among published pages.

checks_performed: Keyword stuffing: no repeated-keyword-density pattern found in sampled pages beyond normal domain-relevant vocabulary.
Hidden text/cloaking: no CSS-hidden text blocks or display:none content-stuffing found in sampled templates.

Doorway pages: no pages exist solely to redirect or funnel to another page without their own content — every page (including the 51 redirected legacy protein URLs) either has real content or is a clean, direct 301, not a soft doorway.

unfinished_sections.evidence: Direct sitewide grep for 'lorem ipsum', 'coming soon', 'under construction', 'placeholder text', 'TODO:' across all published static HTML: 0 matches.

placeholder_content.evidence: Same grep as above — no placeholder markers found anywhere in published content.

template_leakage.evidence: This is exactly what reports/helpful-content-review.json documents in full (the 'canonical' jargon leak, 328 leaf + 56 group + 10 category entities across 4-5 domains). Included here under its site-quality name for completeness rather than re-analyzed — see that report for the full evidence and severity assessment.

known_pre_existing_issues_not_new_to_thi: 4 dead 'View Bottle' (href="#") links on Template A dish pages — confirmed still present (wine-with-steak.html, wine-with-chicken.html, wine-with-salmon.html, and others), unresolved since AQ-01.
Unexplained 'Pairing Strength: XX%' confidence scores on dish pages — unresolved since AQ-01.
Wine-education-tier templated language (category-hub noun-swap sentence) — unresolved since AQ-01.
overall_assessment: Structurally excellent (0 broken/orphaned/duplicate/empty/placeholder pages, fully navigable, fully searchable). The one substantive site-quality concern is the already-documented template-leak/thin-substance issue in 4 domains (reports/helpful-content-review.json), plus 3 smaller pre-existing issues carried forward from AQ-01 that remain unresolved and are outside AQ-06's remediation scope.
